title: validation-store-moves-down-a-rung
intention: The validation store in cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py moves down a rung to a tool, cairn/tools/validation_store/, carrying the record vocabulary it needs (GREEN, RED, VALIDATION_FIELDS and the isolation verdicts SEALED, OPEN, INDETERMINATE, BREACHED), whose charter declares public_interface ['cairn.tools.validation_store.validation_store']; the tester device and every other caller import the store and that vocabulary from the tool, so no component reaches into the tester for a seal.
why: RULE 1 child: 27 encapsulation rows reach into the tester for the seal store; a shared tool is the declared interface
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a component reaches another only through its declared public interface; a device's is the bus) via parent 8e3474a6ae43; Law 6 (a tool has users, not an owner — the seals themselves stay in each component's validations/, gated by its holder); Law 8 (the store is the record every proven-space gate reads).
how: Measured 2026-10-02 (encapsulation_breaches('.') in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py): 214 rows, 27 of them module cairn.devices.tester.validation_store, from cairn/tools/base/validation.py (7), cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (4), and proofs in cairn/tools/base, cairn/tools/artifact, cairn/tools/question, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master and cairn/devices/codemother. The store imports exactly two things from the tester: GREEN and VALIDATION_FIELDS from cairn/devices/tester/device.py and SEALED/OPEN/INDETERMINATE/BREACHED from cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py — record vocabulary, not tester state; no component outside the tester imports cairn.devices.tester.isolation. So the store and that vocabulary move to cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py, device.py and isolation.py import the names from the tool (a device using a tool through its declared interface), and every importer of the old dotted path is rewritten. The tester keeps running proofs and sealing; only the record format and its reader/writer move.
falsifier: RED if: (1) the live encapsulation_breaches('.') carries any row whose module is cairn.devices.tester.validation_store; (2) any .py file or bin/ command names cairn.devices.tester.validation_store, or cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py exists; (3) cairn/tools/validation_store/intention+why.json does not declare public_interface exactly ['cairn.tools.validation_store.validation_store'], or that module imports anything from cairn.devices, or it does not expose standing, persist_validation, record_hollow, read_validations, source_fingerprint and VALIDATION_FIELDS. WRONG INTENT if the store turns out to hold tester state that a tool cannot carry. Horizon: the tester seal of cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_store_is_a_tool.py.
watchme: none, because the encapsulation_holds sieve in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py reds any new import of a device's internals at the next inspect, and the store has no runtime behaviour beyond the seal reads and writes every proof run already exercises
children: none, because the move is one file plus its vocabulary and a dotted-path rewrite; the tester's run verb and its other reaches (device, cli, hollow, scratch_sweep, discovery) are a sibling child of 8e3474a6ae43
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Where? git mv cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py to cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py; new cairn/tools/validation_store/__init__.py and charter through `cairn artifact write --verb charter`. (2) What? move GREEN, RED, VALIDATION_FIELDS out of cairn/devices/tester/device.py and SEALED, OPEN, INDETERMINATE, BREACHED out of cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py into the tool module; device.py and isolation.py import them from cairn.tools.validation_store.validation_store; sed every 'cairn.devices.tester.validation_store' to 'cairn.tools.validation_store.validation_store'. (3) Proof? cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_store_is_a_tool.py, PROVES keys 1, 2, 3, red first.
